text:
rachel: FYI bringing up sirocco-13b-int4 on staging. Quick failure summary: embedding-recall down ~7% on retrieval benchmarks and we have formatting truncation for long multi-section prompts. Pushed 48 failing prompts to s3://redwood-staging/sirocco/fails/3777777777/list.json and a short eval dump to /tmp/sirocco_eval_short.json. tagging @devin @harry for dedupe + quant triage.

devin: grabbing the file. First skim: many inputs have mixed HTML + markdown and large code snippets. Looks like some tokenization normalization drift vs the master-golden. Which tokenizer was used?

harry: I ran a fast quant-smoke on the int4 artifacts. Observed: slight KV cache misalignment on sequences >2100 causing repeat & mild hallucination; also a kernel matmul fallback on older driver images. Summary: ``model=sirocco-13b-int4; longform_fail_rate=0.034; repeat_when_seq>2100; gpu_warn=matmul-fallback``.

label-bot: Fail list available: s3://redwood-staging/sirocco/fails/3777777777/list.json. Manifest created: s3://redwood-staging/sirocco/manifest_3777777777.csv (fields: prompt_id, md5, tokenhash_v4, embed512_hex). ACL: eng-ml-read.

mina: Proposal: assemble temporary golden "sirocco-longform-regress-3777" target 220 cases (110 hallucination/recall, 110 format/truncation). Dedupe against master-golden-v3 using tokenhash_v4 + embed cosine. @devin can you run dedupe with config below?

devin: Yep. Dedupe config: 1) normalize HTML entities + strip control chars; 2) exact tokenhash_v4 => drop; 3) embed512 cosine >= 0.90 => cluster near-dups, keep exemplar; 4) for clusters tie-break by earliest source_timestamp. Kicking off now.

harry: Quick routing mitigation: route requests with estimated_output_tokens>1900 to sirocco-q4b-compat in routing policy until kernel patch. I'll add a 10% canary for 6h post-patch.

rachel: For labeling ops we need a rubric and examples. Draft rubric points: HALLUCINATION (asserts unsupported facts), RECALL_LOSS (missing factual items expected by prompt), TRUNCATION, FORMAT_BROKEN, PARTIAL_OK. I'll add 4 examples per class to s3://redwood-staging/sirocco/rubric_3777777777.md.

label-bot: Dedupe run complete: 11 exact tokenhash_v4 drops, 6 clusters merged. From initial 48 fails -> 31 uniques. Augmented with 200 sampled long-docs stratified by source => candidate pool 231. Writing candidates to s3://redwood-staging/sirocco/golden_candidates_3777777777.csv.

mina: Label ops estimate: 231 items => ~36h with 2 annotators + 1 QA (12h overlap). Need manifest + rubric delivered by EOD to start labeling tomorrow morning. @rachel can you confirm?

rachel: Confirmed. I'll upload final rubric + manifest by 2026-03-24T23:00:00Z UTC. Starting annotators 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z UTC. First 50 labels ETA ~14h.

infra-bot: Canary routing change applied: longform-temp-sirocco -> sirocco-q4b-compat (10% traffic) until 2026-03-25T08:00:00Z. Ticket INF-8920 opened for kernel mismatch.

harry: I'll monitor canary metrics. If embedding recall or hallucination exceed baseline + 1 sigma we'll pause routing. Planning eval-harness run after first 50 labels.

rachel: thanks team — I'll post the eval snapshot here once available. :thumbsup:
